$comment: email-communication-intelligence-r1 task 040 (NFR-07 blocking merge gate) — the email-create-task (Job C) eval family, joined to the SAME Category=GoldenUtteranceEval merge gate via CreateTaskFromEmailEvalTests.cs (identical net-new-family pattern as the triage-email / email-propose / NDA-review families in this directory — no shared golden-utterances.json edit for the family, no CI-YAML change; the trait IS the registration). Like TRIAGE-EMAIL/PROPOSE-FIELD-UPDATES, CREATE-TASK-FROM-EMAIL is NOT chat/loop-projectable — it is invoked directly off the Communication enrichment path (CommunicationEnrichmentService.RunEmailCreateTaskAsync via the ICommunicationCreateTaskAi PublicContracts facade), so 'channel' is uniformly 'event' and 'utterance' is the event/affordance descriptor, not NL phrasing. Five families: structured-output (the Action's own worked example -> the tasks[] output shape {subject, description, dueDate, citation{source, locator, quotedText}, reason, confidence}, cross-checked against BOTH the action file and this seed so either drifting fails a test), verify-cited-text (NFR-06 -- the CitationVerifier drops a fabricated quote, keeps a verbatim span), deadline-confirm (NFR-06/ADR-015 -- a candidate WITH a dueDate is deadline-bearing and MUST route to human-confirm, never auto-finalize; a candidate with none may create immediately), reuse-not-fork (FR-14/ADR-039 -- the create leg is the SAME IActionSeam.CreateTaskAsync/TaskActionCore write core the shipped chat-loop CREATE-TASK@v1 capability's dataverse.create_record tool ultimately backs -- no second create mechanism, grep-verifiable), no-second-pass (FR-05/FR-14 -- the facade has NO classification dependency; the triage output is grounding only).

cases.utterance: [email-create-task] NFR-06 — a candidate whose quotedText IS a verbatim span of the source is kept; a fabricated quotedText is dropped
cases.notes: Demonstrates the verify-cited-text trust gate structurally (mechanical, no live model): CitationVerifier.IsCitedTextPresent returns true when the quotedText is a whitespace/case-normalized substring of the source communication/attachment, and false when it is not — the exact gate CommunicationEnrichmentService applies before creating or storing a candidate. A fabricated (hallucinated) citation is never created or stored.

cases.utterance: [email-create-task] NFR-06/ADR-015 — a candidate WITH a concrete dueDate is deadline-bearing and MUST route to human-confirm (stored PENDING, never auto-finalized); a candidate with NO dueDate may be created immediately
cases.notes: Structural proof of the deadline-bearing -> confirm design: CommunicationEnrichmentService.RunEmailCreateTaskAsync branches on TaskCandidate.DueDate.HasValue — a non-null DueDate skips the IActionSeam.CreateTaskAsync call entirely and leaves the sprk_emailreviewlog Proposed row OPEN (no terminal row), while a null DueDate proceeds to create immediately and writes a terminal Applied row. Proven at the unit level (EmailCreateTaskSeamTests) against the REAL enrichment orchestration.

cases.utterance: [email-create-task] the non-deadline-bearing create leg reuses the SHIPPED create-task write core (IActionSeam.CreateTaskAsync -> TaskActionCore) — the SAME session-agnostic core the chat-loop CREATE-TASK@v1 capability's dataverse.create_record tool ultimately backs. No second task-creation mechanism is introduced.
cases.notes: Grep-verifiable structural proof: CommunicationEnrichmentService references Sprk.Bff.Api.Services.Ai.PublicContracts.IActionSeam and calls CreateTaskAsync — it does not construct a task Entity directly, does not call IGenericEntityService.CreateAsync('task', ...), and does not reference CreateTaskNodeExecutor. The Communication layer's ONLY task-creation call is through the ADR-013 facade.
